objective.primary: Raise supported exact tool.endpoint accuracy while tightening safety toward the standing production target.
objective.latency: paired mean must not regress; p95 must not regress

design_principles: Schema graph remains the sole source of routing authority.
Semantic models may attach evidence only to registered graph nodes/edges.
Prefer safe abstention to an executable false route.
No benchmark-authored alias, synonym, or unsupported-operation term may be added merely because it appears in development failures.
Language normalization and semantic representation changes must be generic and reusable across routes.
Per-language and per-route worst-case slices are first-class promotion evidence.

candidate_research_axes.description: Separate tool-domain, operation-action, response-field/concept, and qualifier views instead of one concatenated embedding surface; combine only over graph-authorized nodes.
Require agreement across operation and field/concept graph paths before direct accept; disagreement lowers confidence or abstains.
Use generic language-independent normalization or multilingual semantic representations without benchmark-specific phrase tables.
Evaluate route siblings and near-domain unsupported operations as explicit negatives while keeping training/tuning data fully separate from calibration/blind corpora.
Resolve tool domain first, then operation within the authorized tool subgraph, with independent abstention thresholds and no cross-tool authority creation.
Calibrate direct-accept versus rerank versus abstain boundaries using development data only, with reliability curves and expected calibration error reported.

forbidden_for_tuning: future v15 unless/until explicitly consumed by its frozen candidate
any future calibration or blind corpus
research_hygiene.current_0_10_graph_dev: may be used only for retrospective diagnosis of the completed 0.10 cycle; do not reuse it as the sole selection corpus for the next cycle
research_hygiene.corpus_generation: Do not generate the next cycle's fresh corpora until the current graph-projection cycle is formally closed.
